The following deadlines apply to graduate programs in the School of Engineering and the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, including the School of the Museum of Fine Arts. Before applying, confirm your program's deadline in the chart below.
Understanding Our Application Deadlines
PhD programs typically have a single application deadline. Most master's and certificate programs offer multiple rounds:
Priority Deadline: Complete applications receive first consideration for admission and are given the strongest consideration for scholarship funding. If funding or cohort space is limited, priority applicants are decided first.
Regular Deadline: Complete applications receive full consideration for admission, though funding may be more limited. We encourage you to apply by the priority deadline whenever possible.
Rolling Admissions Period: After the regular deadline, many programs accept applications until their cohorts are full. Applications are reviewed in the order completed, and decisions are issued on an ongoing basis. Because space and funding are awarded as qualified applicants are admitted, apply as early as possible.
Information for International Applicants
We encourage international applicants to apply as early as possible to allow ample time for visa processing, if needed.
PhD applicants: Most PhD programs have a single deadline for all applicants, regardless of citizenship or visa status.
Master's applicants: We strongly recommend applying by your program's priority deadline. If your program offers multiple rounds, the final deadline to apply depends on your visa status:
If you will be new to studying in the U.S. and will require a new student visa to study at Tufts:
Fall entry: apply no later than the regular deadline (typically April 15)
Spring entry: apply no later than the priority deadline (typically October 1)
If you are currently studying in the U.S. and eligible to transfer your current visa status (SEVIS record) to Tufts:
Fall entry: you may apply by the final deadline listed for your program (typically August 1)
Spring entry: you may apply by the final deadline listed for your program (typically December 1)
Deadlines vary by program, so be sure to confirm the date(s) posted for your program below.
Application Review Timeline
Your application must be complete to be considered for admission. An application is complete once all required materials have been received, including recommendation letters, transcripts, and the application fee (or an approved fee waiver).
Review begins on or near the priority deadline; applications submitted earlier are not reviewed in advance, though early submission helps ensure your application is promptly considered when the review period begins. If your application is complete by the priority deadline, expect a decision within 4 to 6 weeks of that deadline. If it becomes complete afterward, expect a decision within 4 to 6 weeks of the date it becomes complete. We will notify you by email when your decision is available in the application portal.
